messages:
Alex: quick follow-up from the postmortem - we need clear owners for alert cleanup: dedupe/grouping, threshold tuning, and paging cadence. keep changes small and staged.
Priya: I can own grouping/dedupe. plan: add group_by [service, region] + group_interval=9m and repeat_interval=18m. will prototype on the noisy kv-cache service.
Noah: I'll take thresholds. plan: compute 14d rolling baseline per-region, set warning at p90 and page at p99, require 2 evals in 6m to escalate. will push numbers by Tue.
alerts-bot: created INCIDENT-12234 assigned to Priya (dedupe) and INCIDENT-12235 assigned to Noah (thresholds). Links: https://redwood/INCIDENT-12234, https://redwood/INCIDENT-12235
Priya: quick rule I'll test in staging:
```
- alert: KVCache5xxSpike
  expr: increase(kv_errors_total[5m]) > 4
  labels:
    service: kv-cache
    severity: page
```
will combine with Alertmanager grouping and a suppress window for identical instance-origin alerts within 3m.
Noah: also proposing a scale_event label emitted by the autoscaler. treat scale_event=true as warning-only for 4m. that should cut duplicates during churn.
Alex: timelines: Priya due 2026-04-06, Noah due 2026-04-13. weekly sync Fridays 10:00 PT. I'll add owners to the postmortem follow-up table and create the recurring invite.
pd-bot: applied temporary 2h silence to kv-cache-5xx for validation window.
Priya: will enable dedupe in staging for 48h and report unique_alerts vs total_alerts. if duplicates drop >50% we widen rollout.
Noah: will publish baseline CSV and short dashboard widget showing unique alerts, dup rate, and paging volume. putting updates in ticket comments only.
Alex: nice. keep the changes focused; small wins first. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
